properties.label: Group
properties.description: Lanthanides and actinides are listed as group 3.

properties.label: Orbital quantum number l
properties.description: 0 = s, 1 = p, 2 = d, 3 = f block.

properties.label: Metal / metalloid / nonmetal
properties.description: 1 = metal, 2 = metalloid, 3 = nonmetal.

properties.label: Mendeleev number
properties.description: Pettifor-style chemical scale used for structure maps.

properties.label: Family (lab grouping)
properties.description: 1 alkali, 2 alkaline earth, 3 Sc/Y/lanthanides/actinides, 4 transition metals, 5 post-transition metals, 6 metalloids, 7 nonmetals, 8 halogens.

properties.label: Electron affinity
properties.description: Negative values: the anion is unbound.

properties.label: Ghosh electronegativity
properties.description: Rises steeply across the 5d row, hence the log scale.

properties.label: Miracle radius
properties.description: Radii for metallic glasses (Miracle et al.).

properties.label: Electrical resistivity
properties.description: Header says mΩ, but the values are in Ω·m (Ag = 1.6e-8).

properties.label: LDA total energy
properties.description: Free-atom total energy in the LDA approximation.

properties.label: LDA kinetic energy
properties.description: Free-atom kinetic energy in the LDA approximation.

properties.label: LDA electron–electron energy
properties.description: Free-atom electron–electron energy in the LDA approximation.

properties.label: LDA electron–nucleus energy
properties.description: Free-atom electron–nucleus energy in the LDA approximation.

properties.label: LDA exchange–correlation energy
properties.description: Free-atom exchange–correlation energy in the LDA approximation.

properties.label: LSD total energy
properties.description: Free-atom total energy in the spin-polarized LSD approximation.

properties.label: LSD kinetic energy
properties.description: Free-atom kinetic energy in the spin-polarized LSD approximation.

properties.label: LSD electron–electron energy
properties.description: Free-atom electron–electron energy in the spin-polarized LSD approximation.

properties.label: LSD electron–nucleus energy
properties.description: Free-atom electron–nucleus energy in the spin-polarized LSD approximation.

properties.label: LSD exchange–correlation energy
properties.description: Free-atom exchange–correlation energy in the spin-polarized LSD approximation.

properties.label: RLDA total energy
properties.description: Free-atom total energy in the relativistic RLDA approximation.

properties.label: RLDA kinetic energy
properties.description: Free-atom kinetic energy in the relativistic RLDA approximation.

properties.label: RLDA electron–electron energy
properties.description: Free-atom electron–electron energy in the relativistic RLDA approximation.

properties.label: RLDA electron–nucleus energy
properties.description: Free-atom electron–nucleus energy in the relativistic RLDA approximation.

properties.label: RLDA exchange–correlation energy
properties.description: Free-atom exchange–correlation energy in the relativistic RLDA approximation.

properties.label: ScRLDA total energy
properties.description: Free-atom total energy in the scalar-relativistic ScRLDA approximation.

properties.label: ScRLDA kinetic energy
properties.description: Free-atom kinetic energy in the scalar-relativistic ScRLDA approximation.

properties.label: ScRLDA electron–electron energy
properties.description: Free-atom electron–electron energy in the scalar-relativistic ScRLDA approximation.

properties.label: ScRLDA electron–nucleus energy
properties.description: Free-atom electron–nucleus energy in the scalar-relativistic ScRLDA approximation.

properties.label: ScRLDA exchange–correlation energy
properties.description: Free-atom exchange–correlation energy in the scalar-relativistic ScRLDA approximation.

properties.label: Thermal neutron capture cross-section
properties.description: How strongly the element swallows slow neutrons. Gd is the champion.

properties.label: Pettifor number
properties.description: Pettifor's chemical scale: similar elements get neighbouring numbers.

properties.label: Glawe number
properties.description: Data-driven chemical scale from Glawe et al. (2016).

properties.label: Atomic radius (Rahm)
properties.description: Computed radii that also cover the noble gases.

properties.label: Crystal structure of the element
properties.description: Ground-state lattice of the pure element.

properties.label: Miedema φ*
properties.description: Electronegativity-like parameter of Miedema's model for alloy formation enthalpies.

properties.label: Discovery year
properties.description: Blank for elements known since antiquity.

properties.label: Relative supply risk
properties.description: Royal Society of Chemistry supply-risk index.

properties.label: Spin-polarization energy
properties.description: E(LDA) − E(LSD) of the free atom: the energy gained by letting spins polarize. Zero for closed shells, largest for half-filled shells (Hund's rule).
properties.source: Computed from the lab property list

properties.label: Relativistic energy
properties.description: E(LDA) − E(RLDA) of the free atom: the extra binding from relativity, growing roughly as Z⁴. It is why gold is yellow and mercury is liquid.
properties.source: Computed from the lab property list

properties.label: Pugh ratio B/G
properties.description: Bulk over shear modulus; above about 1.75 a metal tends to be ductile.
properties.source: Computed from the lab property list

properties.label: Poisson's ratio
properties.description: From the bulk and shear moduli: (3B − 2G) / (6B + 2G).
properties.source: Computed from the lab property list

properties.label: PCA component 1
properties.description: First principal component of the element properties.
properties.source: Computed from the lab property list

properties.label: PCA component 2
properties.description: Second principal component of the element properties.
properties.source: Computed from the lab property list
